Our Story

Fifty years of Sunbeam. Thirteen in Ballia.

Sunbeam began in Varanasi in 1972, founded by Dr. Amrit Lal 'Ishrat' Madhok and his wife on a conviction that the schools around them were not meeting the whole of a child's needs.

The Ballia campus opened at Agarsanda in 2013 with 456 students, carrying the same conviction into a new district.

  • Founded in Varanasi in 1972 · Ballia campus since 2013
  • 2,200+ students across Science, Commerce and Humanities
  • Nine laboratories, a 15,000-book library and a shooting range

“Lighting the Lamp of Knowledge”

The founding phrase of the Sunbeam group
Read our story

A heritage school, built for what comes next

#1 Co-ed day school in Ballia Education World, six consecutive years — 2019-20 to 2024-25

Principal Speak

A word from our Principal

At Sunbeam School Ballia, we believe that education is not merely about imparting knowledge, but about nurturing character, inspiring creativity, and preparing young minds to lead with empathy and vision.

The Sunbeam vision has always been to empower students with 21st-century skills while staying rooted in Indian culture and moral values. We are committed to holistic development — intellectual growth, physical well-being, emotional resilience and ethical strength.

As Principal, my role is to ensure that every child feels valued, safe, and inspired to achieve their full potential.

Mrs. Arpita Singh

Principal, Sunbeam School Ballia

Read the full message

Teaching & Learning

Learning you can watch happen.

A Sunbeam classroom is meant to be busy. Children build, test, argue a case, fly a drone, run a company, take something apart to see how it works.

The evidence is in the equipment the school actually owns and the certifications its teachers actually hold.

  • Robotics, drones & coding A robotics lab equipped with a drone, a 3-D printer, a telescope and embedded system design.
  • AI & digital literacy A Microsoft Showcase School, with 100 teachers certified as Microsoft Innovative Educator Experts.
  • Nine laboratories Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics, Language, Geography, Srijan, Model UN and Computing.
  • Enterprise from Class VII KIDS Entrepreneurship, plus two computer labs of 40+ machines each.
  • Smart classrooms 30+ digitally smart classrooms and 49+ interactive flat panels.

Academic Blocks

30+ smart classrooms · 49+ interactive panels

Four floors at Agarsanda housing 30+ digitally smart classrooms and 49+ interactive flat panels, with the prayer grounds and playground alongside.

Shooting Range

A facility few district schools have

A dedicated shooting range on the Agarsanda campus — among the least common facilities at any school in the district.

15,000+ books · 25 periodicals
